name: d-lab-5
description: Agent skills for all five D-LAB-5 development domains: the core, DigitalHome.Cloud, ERP-LAB-5, Atelier-5 and artdecoris labs. An entry is a pointer: each skill has one home, the repository that owns its subject, and is listed here, never copied.

plugins.name: dlab5-house
plugins.description: How D-LAB-5 builds on Amplify Gen 2 anywhere: an MCP server over the backend, and API keys as Cognito credentials.

plugins.name: erplab5-house
plugins.description: ERP-LAB-5 house rules: commit conventions, CLI design for the operator tools, and the security audit across BTP, the Cloud Connector and NetWeaver.

plugins.name: sap-cc-operations
plugins.description: Operating the SAP Cloud Connector: admin REST API, the first-run 403s, traces, and NoChannelsAvailableException.

plugins.name: sap-di-rms-api
plugins.description: The SAP Data Intelligence RMS internal API, which the public DI API does not cover.

plugins.name: pytool-kit
plugins.description: Build D-LAB-5 small full-stack Python tools, and edges: scaffold from the template, extend through every layer, take core fixes, release.

plugins.name: di-replication-sync
plugins.description: Compare and promote SAP Data Intelligence replication flows between landscapes. Unofficial; not affiliated with SAP.

plugins.name: metro-map
plugins.description: Draw transit-map diagrams of landscapes, pipelines and roadmaps, rendered to a standalone SVG.
